settings.heading:
Doing everything right,
and still buying on
a leap of faith.
settings.name: Dr Richie Barclay, Founder · PhD, cell biology and nutrition

settings.text: Most of the people I’ve worked with in their 40s and 50s were doing everything right. Training, eating well, taking their supplements. And they still felt it: gone by 3pm, nothing left for the people at home, sitting out the things they love.

Most of what they took, they took on trust. Greens, a supermarket multivitamin, collagen, joint capsules. Labels that didn’t show the doses. Nobody checking every batch. No way to know if any of it was doing anything.

I spent years in the lab studying why our bodies get less back from the same food and training as we age. Then years consulting people just like you. So when I built MUTO, I built it the way I’d want it built for my own family: nothing hidden, everything checkable.

settings.claim: Approval before it goes on sale

settings.heading:
Ten standards.
All of them checkable.

settings.title: 1. Every dose on the label
settings.text:
No proprietary blends. Every one of the 19 ingredients is listed with its exact dose and form, so you know exactly what you’re taking.

How to check: Read the full label, or turn the jar round.

settings.title: 2. Doses chosen for a reason
settings.text:
NR at 300mg, the most allowed in Great Britain. Vitamin D3 at 2,000 IU. B vitamins in their active, methylated forms. Zinc and copper dosed as a pair, because they compete for absorption. Nothing added just to make the list longer.

How to check: Every dose and form is in the ingredient table.

settings.title: 3. Only ingredients authorised in the UK
settings.text:
Every ingredient in MUTO is authorised for use in UK food supplements. That’s why we use NR rather than NMN, which is still under assessment.

How to check: Ask us about any ingredient’s status.

settings.title: 4. Every batch third-party tested
settings.text:
Not just the first batch. Every batch is tested by an independent lab before it’s released.

How to check: Certificates are available on request: hello@mutolongevity.com

settings.title: 5. Made in the UK, to GMP
settings.text:
Manufactured in the UK to GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) standards, in an ISO-certified facility.

How to check: Ask us for our manufacturing standards.

settings.title: 6. Nothing you don’t need
settings.text:
Vegan capsules made from plant cellulose (HPMC). Vitamin D3 from algae. No major allergens, no fillers, no caffeine and no stimulants.

How to check: It’s all on the label.

settings.title: 7. Scientists with names
settings.text:
Formulated by Dr Richie Barclay, PhD in cell biology and nutrition, with a six-member scientific advisory board across sports nutrition, exercise physiology, public health and lifestyle medicine. The board meets every quarter to guide our research and every new formula. It doesn’t endorse products, and none of its members are presented as recommending MUTO for any medical purpose.

How to check: Meet the board below.

settings.title: 8. Research we’ll publish, whatever it shows
settings.text:
MUTO is part of independent university research: a University of Westminster study starts in December 2026, with work at King’s College London, Coventry and Newcastle to follow. There are no results yet, and we’ll never say there are.

How to check: We’ll share every update on this page.

settings.title: 9. Honest claims only
settings.text:
We only make the health claims UK law authorises, worded exactly. We’ll tell you what MUTO won’t do as clearly as what it will. Every review is genuine and invited from every customer, and every creator we work with is disclosed.

How to check: Every claim on our site carries its authorised wording.

settings.title: 10. Built to be checked
settings.text:
Note how you feel today: score your afternoons, or check your wearable. Give it 90 days. If you don’t feel the difference, you get every subscription payment back. Skip, pause or cancel online anytime, with a reminder five days before every payment.

How to check: Guarantee terms are in our FAQs.

settings.title: Is MUTO tested for banned substances?
settings.text: Every batch of MUTO is third-party tested. We don’t currently make a banned-substance certification claim, and we’ll update this page if that changes.

settings.title: Can I see your test results?
settings.text: Yes. Batch certificates are available on request: hello@mutolongevity.com.

settings.title: Why NR and not NMN?
settings.text: NR is authorised for food supplements in Great Britain, at up to 300mg a day for adults. NMN is still under novel food assessment. We only use ingredients that are authorised in the UK.

settings.title: Why 19 ingredients?
settings.text: Because the five jobs need them, and each one has its dose on the label. Nothing is there to make the list longer.

settings.title: Has MUTO been clinically proven?
settings.text: No, and we won’t say it has. Our first human study starts in December 2026 at the University of Westminster. We’ll publish the results, whatever they show.

settings.title: What won’t MUTO do?
settings.text: It won’t make you 25 again, replace sleep, training or a decent diet, or work overnight. It isn’t a stimulant. It’s a daily foundation, and most people give it 60 to 90 days.

settings.title: Is it safe with medication?
settings.text: Check with your GP or pharmacist first if you take any prescription medicine. MUTO contains vitamin K2, which can affect blood thinners such as warfarin. We’re happy to send the full label to share with your doctor.
